{{TierBar}}


'''Primitive Parasites''' are a Tier of [[Mobs#Parasites|Parasites]]. This Tier is placed above [[Assimilated Mobs]] and contains 12 Mobs. 

Parasites part of the Primitive Tier should be approached with caution because of their strong Stats and unique Abilities. Killing all of them at least once grants the player the {{AdvancementLink|Primitive}}.

== ''Shared Aspects and Capabilities'' ==

=== Spawning ===
*Spawned after a successful merging between 4 [[Moving Flesh]], through the usage of the [[Evolution System]]. The result is random;
*Spawn naturally from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 4|Phase 4]] to [[Evolution Phases#Phase 6|Phase 6]];
*Spawned by [[Stage III Beckon|Stage III Beckons]]<ref name=":0">Except for Arachnida.</ref>;
*Spawned inside the [[Parasite Biome]]<ref name=":0" />.
*Spawns when their [[Adapted Parasites|Adapted]] counterpart is killed<ref>Except for [[Adapted Burrower|Adapted Burrowers]], [[Adapted Tozoon|Tozoons]], [[Adapted Devourer|Devourers]], and [[Adapted Vermin|Vermin]].</ref>, if at least one [[Colony]] exists in the dimension.

=== Weaknesses ===
Like all Parasites, Primitives present a weakness to fire (damage inflicted by fire is quadrupled).

=== Capabilities ===
*Primitive Parasites are capable of [[Evolution System|evolving]] into stronger forms: the [[Adapted Parasites]];
*Primitive Parasites are capable of regenerating when out of combat;
**Primitive Parasites obtain the Regeneration Effect after killing something. The Effect lasts enough to regenerate 1 HP;
*Primitive Parasites are capable of performing small leaps, both on land and in liquids, which grants them a movement advantage;
**Primitive Parasites are capable of jumping a certain amount of blocks, depending on the Parasite, in order to reach their targets. [[Primitive Arachnida|Arachnida]] are the only exception, because they are capable of climbing blocks;
*Primitive Parasites will escape from Lava and Magma Blocks after being damaged by them;
*Primitive Parasites inflict the [[Call Of The Hive]] Effect when attacking in Melee;
*Primitive Parasites are capable of [[Adaptation System#Adaptation|adapting]] to Damage Types. The maximum number of Damage Types they can learn is 2;
**Primitive Parasites possess a Damage Cap of 2<ref>This means that, no matter how much Damage a Primitive is receiving, it'll always need at least two hits before going down.</ref>;
**Primitive Parasites have a Minimum Damage of 1<ref>This means that, no matter how much Armor a Primitive's target is wearing, it will always take at least half a heart of damage.</ref>.

=== Griefing Capabilities ===
All Primitives can break blocks that have their [https://minecraft.fandom.com/wiki/Breaking#Blocks_by_hardness Hardness] Value up to 1, with a 60 ticks cooldown and 1 Block range.

After there's a certain amount of dropped items around, Primitives will spawn a [[Parasitic Cyst]], which will slowly clean these items.

=== Post-Death ===

*After dying, all Primitives have a chance to explode, releasing a Potion Cloud which inflicts the Poison and [[Call Of The Hive]] Effects. They will also leave behind [[Remains|Primitive Remains]];
*After dying, all Primitives have a chance to activate the [[Reinforcement System]].

Note: Each Primitive Parasites’ Orb gives an additional effect to either mobs, other parasites, or itself.  See their individual pages for more information.
